common_patterns.overview: Reusable patterns for common OSI data modeling scenarios.

pattern.name: fact_dimension_model
pattern.title: Star Schema: Fact + Dimensions
pattern.description: The most common pattern: a central fact table with foreign keys to dimension tables. Used for sales, transactions, events, and other analytical workloads.
pattern.template: semantic_model: - name: sales_analytics description: Sales analytics semantic model ai_context: instructions: "Use for sales analysis, customer insights, and product performance" datasets: - name: sales source: analytics.public.sales primary_key: [sale_id] description: Sales transactions fact table fields: - name: customer_id expression: dialects: - dialect: ANSI_SQL expression: customer_id description: Foreign key to customer dimension - name: sale_amount expression: dialects: - dialect: ANSI_SQL expression: sale_amount description: Total sale amount - name: customers source: analytics.public.customers primary_key: [customer_id] description: Customer dimension table fields: - name: customer_id expression: dialects: - dialect: ANSI_SQL expression: customer_id - name: customer_name expression: dialects: - dialect: ANSI_SQL expression: customer_name relationships: - name: sales_to_customers from: sales to: customers from_columns: [customer_id] to_columns: [customer_id] metrics: - name: total_sales expression: dialects: - dialect: ANSI_SQL expression: SUM(sales.sale_amount) description: Total sales amount

pattern.name: time_dimension
pattern.title: Time Dimension with Temporal Attributes
pattern.description: A date dimension table with multiple time-granularity fields for time-series analysis.
pattern.template: - name: date_dim source: analytics.public.date_dim primary_key: [date_sk] description: Date dimension with calendar attributes fields: - name: date_sk expression: dialects: - dialect: ANSI_SQL expression: date_sk - name: calendar_date expression: dialects: - dialect: ANSI_SQL expression: calendar_date dimension: is_time: true - name: year expression: dialects: - dialect: ANSI_SQL expression: EXTRACT(YEAR FROM calendar_date) dimension: is_time: true - name: quarter expression: dialects: - dialect: ANSI_SQL expression: CONCAT(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM calendar_date), 'Q', EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM calendar_date)) dimension: is_time: true - name: month_name expression: dialects: - dialect: ANSI_SQL expression: TO_CHAR(calendar_date, 'Month') dimension: is_time: true

pattern.name: composite_relationship
pattern.title: Composite Key Relationship
pattern.description: Relationships where multiple columns form the join key. Common in slowly changing dimensions and line-item fact tables.
pattern.template: relationships: - name: order_lines_to_products from: order_lines to: products from_columns: [product_id, variant_id] to_columns: [product_id, variant_id]

pattern.name: computed_field
pattern.title: Computed/Calculated Fields
pattern.description: Fields derived from expressions rather than direct column references. Used for names, prices, and derived metrics at the field level.
pattern.template: fields: - name: full_name expression: dialects: - dialect: ANSI_SQL expression: first_name || ' ' || last_name description: Customer full name ai_context: synonyms: ["name", "customer name"] - name: extended_price expression: dialects: - dialect: ANSI_SQL expression: quantity * unit_price description: Line item total price

pattern.name: multi_dialect_metric
pattern.title: Multi-Dialect Metric
pattern.description: Metrics with platform-specific expression variations. Essential when the same model targets multiple execution engines.
pattern.template: metrics: - name: year_over_year_growth expression: dialects: - dialect: ANSI_SQL expression: > (SUM(current_year.revenue) - SUM(previous_year.revenue)) / NULLIF(SUM(previous_year.revenue), 0) - dialect: SNOWFLAKE expression: > (SUM(current_year.revenue) - SUM(previous_year.revenue)) / NULLIF(SUM(previous_year.revenue)::FLOAT, 0) - dialect: DATABRICKS expression: > (SUM(current_year.revenue) - SUM(previous_year.revenue)) / NULLIF(SUM(previous_year.revenue), 0) description: Revenue growth year over year

pattern.name: vendor_extension
pattern.title: Vendor-Specific Extensions
pattern.description: Platform-specific metadata embedded in custom_extensions. Allows the same OSI model to carry platform-specific configuration.
pattern.template: custom_extensions: - vendor_name: DBT data: '{"project_name": "analytics", "materialized": "view", "tags": ["daily", "core"]}' - vendor_name: SNOWFLAKE data: '{"warehouse": "ANALYTICS_WH", "database": "PROD", "schema": "PUBLIC"}' - vendor_name: SALESFORCE data: '{"tableau_workbook_id": "sales_dashboard", "einstein_enabled": true}'

pattern.name: ai_context_enrichment
pattern.title: Rich AI Context for LLMs
pattern.description: Structured ai_context that helps LLMs understand business meaning and generate accurate natural language to SQL queries.
pattern.template: ai_context: instructions: "Use this model for retail analytics. Supports time-based analysis, customer segmentation, and product performance metrics." synonyms: - "sales" - "revenue" - "transactions" examples: - "Show me total revenue by month" - "Top 10 customers by purchase amount"
